summary: The Legacy We Left Behind is a narrative-driven educational project exploring the three Lunar Roving Vehicles left on the Moon during NASA's Apollo 15, 16 and 17 missions. Through historical storytelling and scientific information, the project introduces the purpose of the rovers and their contributions to the lunar exploration. It places particular emphasis on Apollo 15, and the first mission to use a Lunar Roving Vehicle. By transforming NASA's mission records and scientific documentation into an narrative story, the project addresses the challenge of bringing attention to human-made objects being abandoned beyond Earth. It aims to preserve the historical and scientific significance of these objects whilst making space exploration more engaging and remind audiences that equipment which are abandoned can still represent remarkable achievements.
details: The Legacy We Left Behind is a narrative driven educational project which explores the three Lunar Roving Vehicles left on the moon during NASA's Apollo 15, 16 and 17 missions. Through chronological storytelling, historical research and scientific information, it introduces readers to the rover's purpose, achievements and lasting legacy. The project aims to make lunar exploration more accessible and engaging whilst raising awareness of the scientific and historical significance of the objects left behind in space. Its creative approach combines both factual mission records with storytelling to transform historical information into an engaging learning experience which everyone will enjoy, making it inclusive. Google docs was used to planning and writing, Canva was used for presentation design, Chatgpt was used for organising my plans and brainstorming, and NASA mission documentation and imagery provided the historical and scientific foundation for the development of my project.
